profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon, a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA. AWS reported revenue of $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker AMZN with SEC CIK 0001018724. The company's website for this profile centers on Amazon SageMaker, which AWS describes as a unified environment for data, analytics, and AI development.

Amazon SageMaker is tracked as a cloud AI and ML lifecycle platform. The company describes it as bringing together model development, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics in a single studio environment called SageMaker Unified Studio. Associated tools include HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps capabilities within SageMaker AI, along with Amazon Q Developer, which the site describes as a generative AI assistant for software development tasks such as data discovery, model building, SQL generation, and pipeline creation. The platform also incorporates Amazon SageMaker Catalog for access policy management, a lakehouse architecture spanning Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift, and built-in governance features including data classification, toxicity detection, and responsible AI controls.

AWS also tracks AWS Bedrock as a second AI product, categorized as a managed foundation model API service. Held facts note that Bedrock includes IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and a component called AgentCore for agent orchestration. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded for AWS in the held facts.
